title: Low pay at the Bucket of Blood and almost becoming a pimp
summary: He earned twenty dollars at best, much lost to tabs, and jokes about not making a pimp.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: So, well, you played -- how much did you get paid for playing there?

At the Bucket of Blood? Well, I was lucky if I got twenty-five dollars, or twenty dollars. But, and I didn't get all of that, because we'd tab half of that up because the rest of your friends would all come in and say, alright what

do you want, and you'd set them up with a drink because you were known as so happy to be a big timer, you'd spend that twenty dollars. Sometimes I'd get paid, with a whole lot of checks that I done signed, and maybe four dollars, sometimes it would be ten dollars. And so I had to quit that. I couldn't make it.
I'd bought a piano for a hundred dollars, and lived where I paid a dollar and a quarter rent. I tried to...
A dollar and a quarter a --

Yeah, so see I tried to, tried to get a couple of girls to do it for me, but they didn't work out so good. So, I didn't say -- I would say that they didn't work out so good. So I had to go to work. Well, I knew how to wait.
So you almost became a pimp.
Yeah, well, only I was a pimple. You see, I couldn't be a pimp because I didn't know what the devil I was doing.
But I was just trying to exist so that I could play.
You know what I mean? I was in it, but I wasn't a part of it, you see what I mean?
